hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); printf '%s | session=%s | branch=%s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"')" "$(git -C /Users/leonard/Workspace/leonard-garden/spring-saas-support-ai rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" >> /Users/leonard/Workspace/leonard-garden/spring-saas-support-ai/.omc/session-log.txt
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH" in *.java) mvn compile -q 2>&1 | tail -5 ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH" in */db/migration/V*.sql) echo '⚠️  WARNING: Editing applied Flyway migration — this breaks schema history! Only add new V*.sql files, never modify existing ones.' ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH" in *TenantContext*|*TenantEntity*|*JwtAuthFilter*|*TenantFilterAspect*) echo '⚠️  Editing tenant-critical file — verify TenantContext.clear() is in a finally block and @Async uses @Async("taskExecutor")' ;; esac
